text: Sizing tokens (number, hug, fill, fill(weight), $token), artboard-local layout, auto-layout (al, gaps, alignment, stretch), valign, backgrounds.

Prefer systematic structure (auto-layout with consistent gaps) over hand-placed p(x,y) coordinates. Hand placement is fine for a few absolute elements; it does not survive content that varies by account/contact.
note: Product note: the founder has said auto-layout groups confuse people editing the ad (the delete-key discussion); worth a ruling on whether the agent should still prefer it.

text: Use hug height for any text that can wrap or vary. Use fill only inside a layout context that can resolve it. Keep text boxes wide enough for the real copy. Do not put mm or renderer-pixel thinking into child values.
note: Third copy of the units rule (F1, F7).

text: Prefer one bounded root frame under each page/artboard (artboard al(v,…) / card al(v,…) example). If a page/artboard or parent-containment diagnostic appears, fix the diagnosed layout cluster rather than shrinking one unrelated child.
Put the background on the container frame, not a separate decorative rectangle … Do not put background(...) on a page creation line, and do not create loose oversized full-canvas bg rectangles.
